title: Yorke - Mirrors
htmlContent:
Yorke's music has lately taken the world by storm. He has yet again unclosed another fire single called "Mirrors." Yorke, who has been performing music for a long time, is competent at expressing his uniqueness through music. He has already verified his artistic capability.

The selection and synthesizers are the perfect backdrops for Yorke to unleash the soulful vocals layered in with boom-bap-inspired drums that ascend and descend in the beat at the ideal moments. "Mirrors" was a track that gave listeners an instant vibe, making you feel like you're high on life cruising in an expensive convertible.

Yorke's "Mirrors" is now available on all streaming platforms!
